note: V1-3 adaptive sales skill library (CAP-039). Metadata is operational, NOT financial authority: no skill may grant a concession, state a floor, or change any business term — numeric authority lives in negotiation-rules.json + products.json only. authority_gated skills (controlled concession, floor protection) are NEVER selected by the ranking/learning logic; they fire only on the engine's structural gates. performance is computed at runtime from captured outcome records (db.negotiations); the stored zeros mean 'no observations yet' — never fake metrics. The learning system may re-rank VALUE skills only (tactics), never the gated ones (authority).

skills.purpose: Establish trust so the customer stays in the conversation and feels heard.
skills.when_to_use: Trust concern; early conversation; after any friction.
skills.when_not_to_use: Customer is ready to buy (do not delay the close).
skills.expected_outcome: Customer continues the conversation with the store, not walking away.
skills.line: Ji, aapki baat dhyan se sun raha hoon. Humara kaam hai ke aapko bilkul clear picture dein — kya mil raha hai, kya included hai. {benefits}

skills.purpose: Understand WHAT the objection actually is (price? competitor? budget? trust?) before responding.
skills.when_to_use: First objection of any kind; unclear motive.
skills.when_not_to_use: Customer already stated a specific price to pay at.
skills.expected_outcome: Objection isolated; response targets the real concern.
skills.line: Ji, price important hai — main bilkul samajhta hoon. Pehle ye dekhiye ke is mein kya included hai: {benefits}. Phir aap bataiye — kis cheez par discuss karna hai?

skills.purpose: Anchor the price against the approved value stack BEFORE any price movement (sell value before reducing price).
skills.when_to_use: Price objection; competitor pressure; budget pressure with approved benefits available.
skills.when_not_to_use: No approved benefits exist for the product (never invent value); customer already ready to buy.
skills.expected_outcome: Customer re-weights price vs included value; concession becomes unnecessary or smaller.
prohibited_situations: claiming benefits not in the approved list
skills.line: Ji dekhien — *{offer}* mein sirf phone nahi, yeh sab included hai: {benefits}. Ye value alag-alag jagah lein to is se zyada lagti hai.

skills.purpose: Frame the purchase as a complete premium experience (unboxing, support, services), not just hardware.
skills.when_to_use: Feature/value interest; premium models; hesitancy after specs discussed.
skills.when_not_to_use: Budget-only objection with no approved premium content for the product.
skills.expected_outcome: Customer evaluates total experience, not hardware price alone.
skills.line: Ji, {name} ek complete premium experience hai — unboxing se le kar support tak. {benefits}

skills.purpose: Use the approved warranty/protection stack to neutralize risk concerns and defend price.
skills.when_to_use: Trust concern; quality doubt; risk-averse customer.
skills.when_not_to_use: No approved warranty/protection benefits for the product; customer asking about repair (that is a service query, not negotiation).
skills.expected_outcome: Risk objection resolved; price defended with included protection.
prohibited_situations: extending warranty terms beyond the approved line
claiming coverage that does not exist
skills.line: Ji tension na lein — {benefits}. Koi manufacturing masla to humari zimmedari hai, aapki nahi.

skills.purpose: Translate specs into daily-use value relevant to the customer's stated interest.
skills.when_not_to_use: Pure price objection with no feature hook.
skills.expected_outcome: Specs become felt value; price objection softens.
skills.line: Ji, aap jo feature dekh rahe hain wo daily use mein kaam aayega. Aur yaad rakhiye — {benefits}.

skills.purpose: Address competitor-price pressure truthfully: never confirm or invent competitor prices; anchor on what the approved price INCLUDES.
skills.when_not_to_use: No approved value stack for the product; customer asking for a price match guarantee (not an approved offer).
skills.expected_outcome: Comparison reframed from price-only to price+inclusions; no fabricated competitor data.
skills.line: Ji, dusre store ke rates main yahan se verify nahi kar sakta — lekin ek cheez clear hai: hamari *{offer}* mein ye sab included hai: {benefits}. Quality aur support mein hum compromise nahi karte.

skills.purpose: Find the real budget constraint and route to the approved EMI option (existing EMI policy) instead of an instant discount.
skills.when_not_to_use: Customer is paying cash at the current price; EMI not applicable to the product.
skills.expected_outcome: Budget concern met via approved EMI path; price held.
skills.line: Ji, budget samajh gaya. {name} ke liye EMI (3-12 mahine) ka option hai — "emi {id}" likhein to plan dikhata hoon. Aasani se manage ho jata hai.

skills.purpose: The ONLY skill that moves the number down — one bounded step, within the owner-approved range, after value-first is satisfied or an explicit price-to-pay is stated.
skills.when_to_use: Engine gate open: product VERIFIED + floor RESOLVED + (value skill already used OR customer stated an explicit price to pay) + offer above floor.
skills.when_not_to_use: NEVER as first response to a discount request; never for STALE/UNKNOWN products; never when floor is unresolved; never when customer is ready to buy at the current offer.
skills.expected_outcome: Smallest justified concession; maximum approved selling price preserved.
prohibited_situations: larger than one step per turn
skills.line: Ji theek hai — main apni taraf se adjust kar raha hoon: *{offer_new}*. Kya hum is par fix kar lein?

skills.purpose: Attempt the close at the current (highest approved) offer — stop negotiating when the customer is ready.
skills.when_to_use: Customer signals readiness; after each concession (re-evaluate → close); after successful value response.
skills.when_not_to_use: Customer actively objecting with no softening (close questions read as pressure).
skills.expected_outcome: Sale at the current approved price.
skills.line: Kya hum *{offer}* par fix kar lein? Theek ho to store par aayen — payment aur delivery wahan hi ho jayegi. 🤝

skills.purpose: Re-engage a customer who pushed back (or walked and returned) at the LAST authorized position — never reopen above it, never below the floor.
skills.when_to_use: Second+ round on the same objection; customer returns after walking away.
skills.when_not_to_use: First turn (that is discovery/value, not re-close).
skills.expected_outcome: Conversation resumes at the last authorized offer without new authority.
prohibited_situations: inventing a new lower price on re-open
skills.line: Ji, khush aamdeed wapis! Aapki baat note ki hui thi. Hum *{offer}* par aage badh sakte hain — {benefits}. Kya ab discuss karein?

skills.purpose: State the floor as the final autonomous position when it is reached; route to the human path instead of inventing new authority.
skills.when_to_use: Offer equals the owner floor AND customer still objects or asks below floor.
skills.when_not_to_use: Above the floor (that is controlled concession territory); first response to a price objection (value-first / SK-03); opening offer; floor unresolved (that is the staff path from the start).
skills.expected_outcome: Floor held; honest final position; CAP-008 human path offered/used.
prohibited_situations: claiming owner approval that does not exist
promising that the owner will approve a lower price
volunteering the floor as the opening or default price
disclosing dealer price / dealer cost / invoice-cost terminology
skills.line: *{offer}* meri aakhri price hai — is se neeche main ja nahi sakta. 🙏 Kya hum is par proceed karein? Warna *staff* likhein — team aapki madad kare gi.
